quests.title: Rás na dTonnta
quests.summary: Raise the crews of the Wild Atlantic Way, boat by boat, for a revived curach race at Dingle.

steps.text: Ask the skipper at the Dingle boat hut about a boat, and look at the Deed counter.
Sing at Dingle's pier bar so the crews hear of the race.
Look at the old Galway hooker at the docks and read the tiller.
Talk to Pádraig, the hooker skipper, at Galway docks.
Pass the Irish lesson with Cailín at the coláiste in Gweedore.
Take the ferry to Tory and sign up the island's rowers.
Win a round of hurling frees for the Club Captain in Cork.
Tell Nóra the crews are in.
Enter the race with the marshal at Dingle marina.
Tell Nóra how the race went.

quests.reward: The Naomhóg Oar charm, standing in Ireland, and a revived regatta at Dingle and Galway.
